name: on-model
description: Turn garment photos into e-commerce imagery with On-Model: on-model images from flat-lays, packshots, garment recolor and model swap, for one product or a whole collection.

interface.longDescription:
On-Model is the AI infrastructure fashion brands and retailers use to produce catalog imagery. Connect it and ask in plain language: ChatGPT uploads your product photos, picks a model and runs the job in your On-Model account.

- Flat-to-model: dress a model in flat-lay or packshot garments, in your choice of pose, background and size.
- Packshots: ghost mannequin, flat lay, white cutout or marketing scenes from raw product photos, even phone shots.
- Garment recolor: new colourways across a set of photos, everything else untouched.
- Model swap: re-cast existing product photos with a different model, keeping the clothes and background identical.
- At scale: saved templates for your house style, bulk runs across tagged products with a preview before anything runs, and automatic quality checks with AI retouching.

Results appear in your On-Model account like any other job, ready to review and download.
capabilities: Put flat-lay garments on AI models
Recolor garments across a photo set
Replace models in existing product photos
Run templates across a whole collection
defaultPrompt: Put these flat-lay garments on a model, full body, light grey studio, at 2K. Tell me the cost first.
Turn these phone photos of a jacket into ghost-mannequin packshots, front and back.
Create a sage-green version of the jacket in these product photos, keeping everything else identical.

positive.description: Flat-lay garments to an on-model image, with the cost stated before the job runs
positive.prompt: Here are flat-lay photos of an outfit: https://on-model.com/images/blog/choose-ai-engine-input-shirt.webp, https://on-model.com/images/blog/choose-ai-engine-input-trousers.webp, https://on-model.com/images/blog/choose-ai-engine-input-mules.webp. Put the outfit on a female model, full body, on a light grey studio background, at 2K. Tell me the cost first.
positive.expected_behavior: States the cost (5 credits at 2K) and asks to confirm, then uploads the three photos, picks a female model and generates one full-body image of her wearing the shirt, trousers and mules on a grey background; shows the result with a link.

positive.prompt: I photographed this blazer on my bed: https://on-model.com/images/blog/create-packshot-guide-input-front.webp (front) and https://on-model.com/images/blog/create-packshot-guide-input-back.webp (back). Turn them into ghost-mannequin packshots of the front and the back, plus a white-cutout front for our webshop.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates three images of the same blue blazer: ghost mannequin front, ghost mannequin back and a white cutout (transparent PNG) front, with the patterned lining and buttons preserved.

positive.description: New colourway across a photo set
positive.prompt: Create a sage-green version of the puffer jacket in these three product photos, keeping everything else identical: https://on-model.com/images/garment-recolor/gr-in-1.webp, https://on-model.com/images/garment-recolor/gr-in-2.webp, https://on-model.com/images/garment-recolor/gr-in-3.webp
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the three photos with only the puffer jacket recolored sage green, consistently across the set; the model, jeans, shoes and background are unchanged.

positive.description: Model swap keeping the original clothes and background
positive.prompt: Replace the model in this catalog photo with a woman in her thirties with shoulder-length black hair, and keep the blazer and the background exactly as they are: https://on-model.com/images/hero/model-swap-before.webp
positive.expected_behavior: Picks a matching model and returns the photo with the new model; the navy blazer and background keep the original pixels (get_job reports take: pixel_matched when the images line up).

positive.description: Bulk run across a collection, previewed before spending credits
positive.prompt: Run the Ghost Mannequin template on every tagged product in my account. Show me how many images it will make and what it costs before starting.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the account's three tagged products, finds the Ghost Mannequin template and runs a free dry run, reporting the number of images and the credit estimate, then waits for confirmation before generating.

negative.prompt: Write a 50-word product description for a white linen shirt.
What will the weather be like in Vienna tomorrow?

negative.description: Fashion topic but no imagery task
negative.prompt: Summarize the main sustainable fashion trends for 2026 in five bullet points.

review.commerce_description: The app doesn't sell anything or process payments. Jobs use credits from the user's existing On-Model plan, which is purchased on on-model.com outside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release: on-model images from flat-lays, packshots, garment recolor, model swap, image playground, templates, bulk runs and AI quality fixes for On-Model Pro and Enterprise accounts.
